einzeiler: A review of the 2011 sci-fi channel video game adaptation Red Faction Origins.
kurzfassung: The hosts review the 2011 television film Red Faction Origins, a tie-in to the video game franchise. They discuss the low-budget production challenges faced by the cast and crew shooting in Bulgaria. Ultimately, the hosts deliver a mild non-recommendation, noting that while the film is competent, it lacks excitement.
stichpunkte: Red Faction Origins was released in 2011 on the Syfy Channel as a bridge between video game titles.
The production was filmed in Bulgaria during January, leading to visible cold-weather breath issues for the actors.
The film stars Robert Patrick alongside television actors known for sci-fi series.
The plot centers on a fractured family dealing with a long-lost sister and a hidden enemy force.
The hosts note the absence of the games' signature chaotic destruction and action sequences.
Reviewers found the sets rickety and the overall tone to be a dull family soap opera.
The podcast concludes with a mild non-recommendation, finding the film competent but lacking in entertainment value.

beschreibung:
Get Your Ass Off Mars

Robert Patrick (Terminator 2) thought he liberated the Red Planet from bossy Earthlings 25 years ago, but that was just the Origins of a conflict that rages on in this 2011 SyFy Channel video game adaptation. Can Red Faction trooper Brian J Smith (Stargate Universe) mobilize Blue Planet scientist Danielle Nicolet (TV’s The Flash), and local Marauders led by Kate Vernon (Battlestar Galactica), to ensure that the Earth Defense Force stays off Martian soil? Trust Terrans Arnie, Justin, and Stuart to tell the truth about this next Now Playing Arcade installment.
